description: List 12 ready-made video templates (kind "video": history facts, scary stories, motivation, personal finance education, kids music, product ad, small-business explainer, character mini-episode and more) and 26 AI motion clip templates (kind "motion": single-shot prompts for landscapes, macro food, animals, products, abstract loops, city nights, weather, miniatures, fantasy scenery and short-drama beats in thriller, comedy, horror, romance, action, epic and drama; the clips are silent, and any person is only a silhouette, seen from behind or as hands, never a face or a child). A video template has the full prompt, length, credit price and the exact arguments for autoshort_generate_chat_video. A motion template has the full prompt, genre, a six-slot breakdown (camera, subject, action, setting, style, lighting: each phrase is literally in the prompt), a one-line why, seconds, credits, a demoVideoUrl when a sample clip exists, and the arguments for autoshort_generate_motion_clip (pass its id as templateId, or edit the prompt and pass it as prompt). 6 short-drama episode scripts (kind "episode", 30-60 s multi-shot episodes for Character Studio; listed only with kind "episode" or an id) carry a script, logline and cliffhanger. An episode is only made as one of the episodes of a reviewed, confirmed season plan: add it to a plan with autoshort_save_season_plan (at least 3 episodes, the cast, the narrator voice and the style), review and confirm it, then autoshort_quote_character_episode prices it for free. Edit any prompt first (swap the topic, shop name or facts). Pass kind "video", "motion" or "episode", id for one template, genre (drama, thriller, comedy, horror, romance, action, epic, nature, product, fantasy) to filter motion and episode templates, or niche (video templates) to filter. Nothing is created or charged; show the user the price before you generate. Free.

genre.description: Only motion and episode templates of this genre (episode scripts exist for drama, thriller, comedy, horror and romance).

kind.description: video = Chat to Video templates, motion = AI motion clip templates, episode = short-drama scripts for a season plan (autoshort_save_season_plan; only returned when asked for with kind "episode" or id). Default: video and motion.

niche.description: Only templates for this niche (see autoshort_list_niches).

name: autoshort_list_templates
